topics.title: Reader V1 and the laboratory workflow
text: Laboratories need results that can be trusted, explained and delivered through a workable process. Manual observation can preserve valuable expert judgement, but it can also leave measurement context dispersed across images, worksheets and information systems. Automation is useful when it improves a defined part of that process without removing the evidence a reviewer needs.

text: AMReye.AI APEX XR is the top-of-the-line clinical + research + bio-automation configuration of the AMReye.AI platform. Its purpose is to unite standardized plate imaging, direct broth microdilution, controlled incubation, research phenomics, multimodal sensing, plate and liquid handling, traceable data management and laboratory orchestration in one system.

The product thesis is practical: preserve accepted microbiology methods, instrument them, make their execution observable, and convert every sample into a reviewable digital record. The clinical pathway begins with measurement and workflow support; the research pathway uses the same chamber, optics and automation to produce time-resolved phenotypic datasets.

topics.title: RTOS and independent embedded control
text: The proposed STM32 control layer runs time-sensitive hardware tasks independently of the operator interface and AI computer. FreeRTOS is an RTOS for microcontrollers; its presence alone does not establish that an AMReye.AI controller is deterministic or safe. The project must define and test its own deadlines, priorities and fault responses. [S21][S22][S24]

Separate acquisition timing, thermal control, interlock monitoring and communications into bounded tasks. Use explicit state transitions, short interrupt handlers and traceable command acknowledgements. Slow image inference, cloud sync and interface rendering must not block essential hardware responses.
